relations_to.summary: The Security Council reauthorised EUFOR Althea for 12 months on 31 Oct 2025 by 15-0-0 (Resolution 2795), and adopted a presidential statement on 29 Dec 2025 reaffirming Bosnia's sovereignty and territorial integrity. relations_to.summary: Withdrawal from the Ottawa Convention on anti-personnel mines: instrument deposited 10 Jul 2025, effective 10 Jan 2026, citing the deteriorated security environment after Russia's full-scale invasion; Finland says it will respect other humanitarian law and has begun planning to reintroduce mines. Poland and the Baltic states left the treaty in the same wave.

relations_to.summary: Lithuania withdrew from the Convention on Cluster Munitions (Seimas vote 18 Jul 2024, effective 6 Mar 2025) and from the Ottawa anti-personnel mine ban convention (Seimas vote 8 May 2025, 107 in favour; notified 27 Jun, effective 27 Dec 2025), the first state to leave a humanitarian disarmament treaty over these two; the defence ministry opened talks to buy or produce mines, to be built with Finland for Lithuania and Ukraine.
